correct_completion: she sent it to her manager.
full_sentence: Having finished the report, she sent it to her manager.
acceptable_variants: she then emailed it to her manager.
she handed it to her manager.

options.text: is going to the park tonight.
options.why_wrong: The stem is a participle clause about a finished action. 'Is going' introduces an unrelated plan and does not complete the clause.

options.text: she was very tired and hungry.
options.why_wrong: This describes a state, but it does not give the main action that follows a participle clause about finishing a task.

options.text: she sent it to her manager.
the report was on her desk.
options.why_wrong: This describes the report, not the action of the subject that follows the finished task.

explanation: A perfect participle clause shows an action completed before the main action. The main clause must have the same subject as the participle clause, here 'she'.
